phrase.zh: 山河之中，始终有具体的人。
phrase.en: Within a landscape, there are always human lives.

visual.zh: 杜甫的生成形象置于山水与层叠纸页之间，让个人目光与时代处境相遇。画面不是某首诗的唯一图解，更不是战乱现场的记录。
visual.en: A generated Du Fu figure sits among landscape and layered pages, joining a personal gaze with historical circumstances. This is neither a definitive illustration of one poem nor a record of a wartime scene.

background.zh: 诗歌基金会将杜甫生卒记为 712—770 年，并介绍他在漂泊中书写亲历的饥荒、政治动荡与个人悲剧。这个背景使山河意象同时关乎生活中的人；不能只把它读成与现实无关的风景。
background.en: The Poetry Foundation dates Du Fu to 712–770 and describes his writing about famine, political unrest and personal tragedy during an itinerant life. This background makes landscape a setting for lived experience as well as scenery.
